title: Collatz, finite-cycle route
statement: The Collatz map T(n)=n/2 for even n and T(n)=3n+1 for odd n has no positive-integer cycle other than 1→4→2→1.

counterexample.description: A nontrivial positive-integer cycle, encoded by its values or parity word; exact integer transitions are a cheap check. This target intentionally excludes a divergent orbit, which is not finitely certifiable.
